name: Strahnbrad camp soldiers (sergeant, boy runner, lieutenant, officers, Silver Hand)

physicalDetails.detail: Sergeant at the gap in the hedge: a spear and a beard grey with dust; holds the spear crossways more to stop the horses than to threaten. Boy runner sent between the tents, splashing. Two officers arguing on either side of a banner pole about a ford; later they carry a board with a map pinned to it into the space Arthas leaves, one shifting the board so its corner will not touch Jaina's staff. A lieutenant (the officer told to see them fed) picks his way across the mud toward the party. Near the stream, men in heavy plate on horses with white tabards and the silver hand stitched on each (Silver Hand, unnamed). A man with a rag over nose and mouth walks an empty army wagon down; two big heavy-footed horses with wide flat shoes.

voiceMarkers.detail: Sergeant: 'Hold there. Who's this?' / 'Everybody knows him, miss.' Officers shout about a ford. Lieutenant is addressed and says nothing on page ('He stood aside for her').

goalsAtChapterEnd.active: Hold the camp and fight the orcs.

emotionalStateAtChapterEnd.state: Busy, indifferent to the party; courteous in a minimal way.

decisionsThisChapter.detail: Sergeant checked the four riders, bawled for a boy, sent word to Arthas, and waited with them. Lieutenant was ordered to feed and water them and was thanked and refused by Jaina.

bodyLanguagePatterns.detail: Every man on the eastern picket line looks at the far hills; archers on the earth bank above the stream have their backs to the road; wagons file in behind the cook-tents and nobody turns to see what is in them; one sergeant and a hedge guard the south-road side.

arc.currentPosition: Background. Unnamed. No named Silver Hand or army officers besides Arthas (no Uther, no Falric).
